name: Cumin Steak with Tomato-Cucumber Salad & Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; transfer to a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes and add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Peel and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the garlic sauce.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide salad and steak between plates. Serve with garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
